question: Should the repair lane adopt this exact head's fail-closed mutation boundary, including stopping publication or follow-up writes when freshness, required-check state, renewed state credentials, or a one-shot mutation outcome cannot be proven?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent and well tested, but it intentionally trades some repair availability for stronger authorization and mutation safety; repository evidence cannot choose that operational policy on the maintainer's behalf.

options.title: Approve the fail-closed rollout
options.body: Finalize the draft and merge the exact green head, accepting blocked or requeued repairs as the intended response to unproven mutation authority.

options.title: Keep the rollout staged
options.body: Leave the PR open while narrowing guards or adding operator recovery and monitoring requirements before the new boundary becomes authoritative.
